references.text: The burnt offering was to be a bull from the herd, a male without defect, as described in the law concerning the burnt offering.
The ram for the burnt offering was to be without defect, in accordance with the regulations for burnt offerings of livestock.
A one-year-old lamb without defect was to be used for the burnt offering, as mentioned in the consecration ceremony.
The burnt offering from the herd or flock was to be a male without defect so that it would be accepted by the Lord.
Identical offering list from Nahshon's gift, showing that each tribal prince gave the same burnt offering.
Eliab's burnt offering was identical: a bull, a ram, and a one-year-old lamb.
At the new moon festival, young bulls, rams, and one-year-old lambs were to be offered as burnt offerings.
One-year-old lambs were standard for the daily burnt offering on the altar.
